Question: Assalamaikum.i saw a dream whr i saw ke i performing namaaz and after doing sijdaah wen i get up i see that thr r drops of my urine on the place whr i did sijdaah 2 times i did sijdaah n same thing happend? Answer ID: 15314 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1484/1211=D/1430) Pay special attention to salah and prayers. The dream indicates that the troubles will go away and the debts will be paid off in-sha-Allah. If there is no trouble or debt, give some charity, you shall be protected against evils. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
